title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mrs. Justice M. K. Thakker on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 06/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;
1. Hon’ble Mrs. Justice M.K.Thakker would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice M. R. Mengdey
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mrs. Justice M.K.Thakker.)
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
